Welcome to my channel! My name is Christina, and I’m here to help you break free from chronic pain and rediscover a life of strength, mobility, and wellness. As a licensed massage therapist with over two decades of experience, I’ve dedicated my career to empowering people to transition from pain to thriving health through natural, holistic methods. Whether you’re dealing with ongoing discomfort or looking for ways to improve mobility,  you’re in the right place.

Learn more about:
Self-Massage Techniques: Easy tutorials to target problem areas and release tension.
Stretching and Mobility Routines: Simple routines to improve flexibility and reduce stiffness.
Chronic Pain Management Tips: Strategies that make a real difference, from tracking tools to identifying pain triggers.
Holistic Wellness Advice: Natural ways to support your health, from better sleep to stress reduction.
Expert Insights: Easy-to-understand explanations of complex topics like inflammation, nerve pain, and posture.
